acceptanceDecision: Current T41 exact-src assertion is incompatible with the current blanket outbound-referral rule for unsigned third-party image URLs. Treat T41 as a product defect only with a documented exception for person-opened captured raw media/assets, preserving referral tagging for webpage links. A test expectation alone cannot resolve the policy conflict.
